import polars as pl

NULL_VALUES = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL", "None"]

def _clean_str(expr: pl.Expr, name: str) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.when(expr.is_in(NULL_VALUES)).then(None).otherwise(expr).alias(name)

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Pre-clean strings
    df = raw.with_columns(
        [_clean_str(pl.col(c), c) for c in raw.columns]
    )

    # 1. contact_id: constant null (string)
    contact_id = pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.String).alias("contact_id")

    # 2. full_name: Contact Name
    full_name = pl.col("Contact Name").alias("full_name")

    # 3. email: Mail lower case
    email = pl.col("Mail").str.to_lowercase().alias("email")

    # 4. phone: E.164 phone number conversion for NZ ("64")
    # Clean non-digit characters and prepend '+'
    phone_cleaned = (
        pl.col("Phone Number")
        .str.replace_all(r"\D+", "")
    )
    phone = (
        pl.when(phone_cleaned.is_not_null() & (phone_cleaned != ""))
        .then(pl.concat_str([pl.lit("+"), phone_cleaned]))
        .otherwise(None)
        .alias("phone")
    )

    # 5. company: Employer
    company = pl.col("Employer").alias("company")

    # 6. created_on: Date from datetime
    created_on = (
        pl.col("Created Date")
        .str.strptime(pl.Datetime, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", strict=False)
        .cast(pl.Date)
        .alias("created_on")
    )

    # 7. lifetime_value: Revenue with decimal="," and thousands="."
    revenue_cleaned = (
        pl.col("Revenue")
        .str.replace_all(r"\.", "")
        .str.replace(r",", ".")
    )
    lifetime_value = (
        revenue_cleaned
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2)
        .alias("lifetime_value")
    )

    return df.select([
        contact_id,
        full_name,
        email,
        phone,
        company,
        created_on,
        lifetime_value,
    ])
